pages.title: Trial by Fire
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find the Burning Arena and use the native awakening. This optional encounter does not award a campaign eye.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: At the Burning Arena obtain ashes from Ignited Revenants; suitable critical axe attacks address their shields. The ashes feed the fire altar.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Ignited Revenant is an arena sentry and ash source, not another eye-bearing MAIN.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Offer Burning Ashes at the Altar of Fire; native summoning does not override dedicated hosted Start.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Native messages mention Ignited Berserkers in Nether Fortresses after Ignis and Coral Golems in oceans after Leviathan. Actual JEM spawning is not guaranteed by a message.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Flame Eye locates Burning Arena. A native locator does not replace canonical JEM admission. Check its current acquisition recipe.
